neighbours.label: the token ' now' right after an auxiliary or modal (has now, can now)
fire: The museum has now reopened its east wing to visitors.
After months of training, our team can now run ten miles.
The farmers have now harvested most of the wheat.
With the new update, users can now share files offline.
The committee has now approved the final budget.
I have now read every book on the reading list.
The patients will now be moved to the new ward.
Scientists have now mapped the entire genome of the plant.
quiet: The museum has recently reopened its east wing to visitors.
After months of training, our team can easily run ten miles.
The farmers have already harvested most of the wheat.
With the new update, users can finally share files offline.
The committee has just approved the final budget.
I have finally read every book on the reading list.
The patients will soon be moved to the new ward.
Scientists have recently mapped the entire genome of the plant.

notes: Card: ' now' is 32/32 of the top, always after have/has/can. Probe: 'Right now' at sentence start does not fire; sentences without ' now' do not.
